what: Null residuals of the orbit bus (superdough's Orbit: the stereo summing node with up-mixing, the gain-1 output, the pan-0 StereoPanner of connectToDestination, the splitter to merger routing channels[i] % count) against the Chromium micro-case references, and the thresholds derived from them.
residual: 20*log10(rms(chromium - engine) / rms(chromium)) over every sample of both channels, no alignment search
marginRule: a bit-exact case (-inf) gets -140 dB, as in engine-null-micro-filters.json; pan-orbit-stems gets -300 dB so the threshold pins the pan-0 panner's leak (about -333 dB without it)
determinism: a second `bun run engine:refs pan-orbit-stems orbit-mix-two` (no --write) reported 'refs are current'; at most two voices overlap per orbit and at most two orbits share a channel, so Blink's hash-set summing order cannot change a bit

pan-orbit-stems.notes: Panned sawtooths (pan 0 and 1) on orbit 2, a panned triangle with dry 0.6 on orbit 3 (two orbits on the mix pair). Bit-identical. With the orbit's pan-0 panner bypassed (orbit output = summing bus) it measures -333.25 dB: the difference is only the cos(pi/2) = 6.1e-17 leak of the right channel into the left.

orbit-mix-two.notes: A mono sawtooth on orbit 1 and a panned square on orbit 2, summed at the merger's inputs 0 and 1. Bit-identical.

otherCases.pan-mono-center: was -333.40 dB (only the orbit pan-0 leak missing); -inf with the orbit bus. Threshold unchanged (-140).
otherCases.pan-sweep: was -334.52 dB (only the orbit pan-0 leak missing); -inf with the orbit bus. Threshold unchanged (-140).
otherCases.filter-24db, filter-ftype-numeric, filte: unchanged (-155.41, -181.59, -159.65, -165.55, -161.05 dB): last-bit differences of sums of three or more voices, whose order Blink's hash-set summing junction leaves undefined (and Chromium's main-thread disconnect race reorders between runs). Every other micro case stays -inf.
